items.claim: Clipped node's scroll box keeps catching presses after its pose goes null

items.claim: `place` reads the style the edit opened with after a restyle
items.note: `place` now reads the style the edit holds, and a restyle places the overlay again at once. This commit also holds the one-line form of 399793807d's `cancelEdit`, made to get `useTextEdit` back under `check:size`.

items.claim: Overlay placed with the opening style, not the rewritten one
Undo/redo with no readable present drops it from history
items.note: The step is refused, as the finding suggested.

items.claim: Plain-text paste keeps a lone CR that HTML paste turns into LF

`normalizeSmallCaps` drops a `
` inside a small-caps run span
items.note:
A `
` is now read as a line feed, both in `sourceText` and in `piecesMatch`. The "block boundary" part is not fixed, because a run span doesn't know whether text came before it in other runs.

items.claim: Negative `startEdit` caret throws from the opening effect
items.note: The caret is clamped in `charOffsetToDomPosition`, and the docs now say so.

items.claim: `restoreOverlayFocus` scrolls a clipped box back to its start
items.note: `OverlayScroll.focus` now also focuses with `preventScroll`. The test checks the option passed to `focus()`, since jsdom never scrolls.

items.claim: Test harnesses use `in` on a user-keyed table
items.note: The harness's `getText` was fixed too. This only touches the test helpers, so it has no changeset.
